tier0.name: Master Compiler & Linker Chassis
tier0.description: Root entrypoint chassis that binds, compiles, and serves all downstream tiers. Guarantees zero-CORS execution under file:/// and HTTP.

tier1.name: Presentation & Graphics Canvas
tier1.description: Everything the human experiences on screen: CSS layout and all browser JavaScript (Three.js 3D universe, audio synthesis, station UI controllers, app loop).

tier2.name: Agents & Operating System Automation
tier2.description: Background workers, system-level automation, local server launchers, and agents executing tasks in the host environment.

tier3.name: Silicon & Bare Metal Compute
tier3.description: Direct hardware instruction sets, compiled binaries, and memory buffers. Pure compute without garbage collection.
